Welcome to Oakbrook Veterinary Clinic

Compassionate pet care for your beloved companions

At Oakbrook Veterinary Clinic, we believe every pet deserves exceptional medical care in a calm, welcoming environment. Our experienced veterinarians and caring staff are dedicated to keeping your furry, feathered, and scaled friends healthy and happy.

View Our Services Schedule an Appointment

Why Choose Oakbrook?

Experienced Veterinarians

Our team includes board-certified veterinarians with over 60 years of combined experience in small animal medicine.

Comprehensive Care

From routine check-ups and vaccinations to dental care and surgical procedures, we offer a full range of veterinary services.

Modern Facilities

Our state-of-the-art clinic is equipped with advanced diagnostic tools and a comfortable recovery area for your pet's peace of mind.

Fear-Free Certified

We're committed to reducing anxiety and fear in pets during veterinary visits through gentle handling techniques.

Preventive Medicine

We focus on keeping your pet healthy through preventive care, nutrition counseling, and wellness programs.

Pet-Focused Environment

Our clinic is designed with pets in mind, featuring separate waiting areas and calming décor to reduce stress.

Hours of Operation

Monday – Friday 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM
Saturday 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM
Sunday Closed

Emergency Contact

For emergencies outside our regular hours, please contact our emergency partner:

Riverside Emergency Veterinary Hospital

Phone: (217) 555-0923

Available 24/7 for urgent care

Please call us first at our main number if possible. We will provide instructions for emergency care.

Ready to Care for Your Pet?

Whether it's time for a wellness check, vaccination update, or you're looking to find a trusted veterinarian for your new family member, we're here to help.

Our Services

Oakbrook Veterinary Clinic offers comprehensive care for dogs, cats, and small animals. From routine wellness visits to specialized treatments, our experienced team is dedicated to keeping your pets healthy and happy.

Services We Offer

Wellness Exams

Regular health check-ups to monitor your pet's overall health, catch potential issues early, and ensure vaccinations are up to date.

From $65

Schedule Now

Vaccinations

Essential immunizations including rabies, DHPP for dogs, and FVRCP for cats to protect against common diseases.

$45–$120

Schedule Now

Dental Care

Professional teeth cleaning, extractions, and oral health assessments to prevent dental disease and maintain your pet's quality of life.

From $180

Schedule Now

Surgery

Spay and neuter procedures, mass removals, and other surgical interventions performed in our fully equipped surgical suite with anesthesia monitoring.

$300–$850

Schedule Now

Diagnostic Imaging

Digital X-rays and ultrasound services to diagnose injuries, internal health issues, and confirm pregnancy in your pets.

$150–$400

Schedule Now

Laboratory Services

In-house blood work, urinalysis, and parasite testing for quick, accurate results and faster treatment decisions.

$75–$250

Schedule Now

Microchipping

Permanent pet identification that increases the chances of your lost pet being returned home safely.

$35

Schedule Now

Allergy Testing & Treatment

Identification and management of food and environmental allergies to help your pet live more comfortably.

$200–$600

Schedule Now

Parasite Prevention

Monthly treatments to protect against fleas, ticks, heartworms, and intestinal parasites with prescription products.

$15–$40/month

Schedule Now

Nail Trimming & Grooming

Professional nail care, ear cleaning, and basic grooming services to keep your pet comfortable and healthy.

$20–$50

Schedule Now

Behavioral Consultation

Expert advice on pet behavior issues, training concerns, and anxiety management to improve your relationship with your pet.

$75–$150

Schedule Now

Emergency Care

24/7 emergency services for sudden illness, trauma, or after-hours concerns. Our team is always ready to help when your pet needs immediate care.

$200+ depending on treatment

Contact Emergency

Give us a call or use our online contact form to book your pet's next visit. Our friendly staff is here to answer any questions about our services.

HomeServicesOur VetsContact

Our Veterinarians

Meet the experienced and compassionate veterinarians at Oakbrook Veterinary Clinic. Each member of our team is dedicated to providing the highest standard of care for your beloved pets.

Dr. Sarah Mitchell

DVM, University of Illinois

Dr. Mitchell is the founder and lead veterinarian at Oakbrook Clinic with over 12 years of experience in small animal medicine. She specializes in preventative care and has a particular passion for feline health.

Specialties:
  • Preventative medicine
  • Feline health
  • Nutrition counseling

Dr. James Chen

DVM, Colorado State University; Cert. in Orthopedic Surgery

Dr. Chen joined our team 8 years ago and brings extensive expertise in surgical procedures and orthopedic care. He is known for his gentle approach and thorough patient assessments.

Specialties:
  • Orthopedic surgery
  • Soft tissue surgery
  • Arthroscopy

Dr. Emily Rodriguez

DVM, Texas A&M University; Cert. in Emergency & Critical Care

Dr. Rodriguez is our emergency medicine specialist with 6 years of experience in high-pressure critical care settings. She is compassionate, detail-oriented, and always available to help pets in urgent situations.

Specialties:
  • Emergency medicine
  • Critical care
  • Trauma assessment

Dr. Michael Thompson

DVM, University of Wisconsin; Cert. in Dermatology

Dr. Thompson has been practicing veterinary medicine for 10 years with a special focus on dermatology and allergy management. He takes time to educate pet owners about skin health and treatment options.

Specialties:
  • Dermatology
  • Allergy management
  • Behavioral medicine

Why Choose Our Team?

Continuous Learning

Our veterinarians stay current with the latest advances in veterinary medicine through regular continuing education and professional development.

Compassionate Care

Every member of our team treats your pets as if they were their own, providing gentle, patient, and thorough care in a calm, welcoming environment.

Collaborative Approach

Our veterinarians work together to ensure comprehensive care for your pet, consulting with one another on complex cases to achieve the best outcomes.
